title: My bones
examples: What are the main parts of my skeleton?
How do my bones help me move?

explain.say: Today we learn about your amazing bones. Bones are hard parts inside your body. They give your body its shape and support.

draw.text: Bones give body shape and support.

explain.say: Now look! Here it is in 3D: the human skeleton. Can you see the skull and the ribcage? Tap any part, and I will tell you about it.
Your skull is a very important bone. It wraps around and protects your brain inside. Your brain needs this safe home.
Next we look at your ribs. Your ribs are curved bones that protect your chest. They keep your heart and lungs safe inside.
Bones help you stand up tall. Your leg bones connect to your hip bones. This strong frame lets you walk and run.
When you jump up high, your bones help keep you steady. They act like a strong frame for your whole body.

draw.text: Bones are your body's strong frame.

explain.say: Sometimes people think muscles do all the work. But bones give the structure that muscles pull on. Bones are the support beams.

faq.q: What is the main job of my bones?
faq.a: The main job is to give your body its shape and provide a strong support frame for everything else.
asks: Why do I have a skeleton?

faq.q: Do my bones protect my organs?
faq.a: Yes, the skull protects your brain, and your ribs protect your heart and lungs.
asks: Is my brain safe inside my body?

faq.q: Are my bones hard all the time?
faq.a: No, your bones are strong but they can grow and change as you get older. Eating healthy foods helps them stay strong.
asks: How do I keep my bones healthy?

faq.q: Do I need muscles to move my bones?
faq.a: Yes, your muscles pull on your bones to make you move. Bones are the anchor points for those muscles.

faq.q: What is the difference between my skull and my ribs?
faq.a: The skull protects your head and brain, while the ribs protect the soft parts in your chest area.
asks: Which bone is around my chest?
What bones are near my head?

facts: The skeleton is made up of many different bones working together.
The skull is a strong cage that keeps your brain safe.
Your ribs form a cage around your chest organs.
Bones help give your body its overall shape.

quiz.say: Which body part primarily protects your brain?
quiz.why: The skull is specifically shaped to enclose and protect your delicate brain.

wrong.1: Muscles are for movement, not for forming a hard protective shell around the brain.
wrong.2: Ribs protect your chest organs, not the brain in your head.
wrong.3: The spine supports your back, but the skull is the head's protective bone.

quiz.say: What do your ribs mainly protect?
quiz.why: The curved bones of the ribs create a cage around your vital chest organs.

wrong.0: The spine protects the spinal cord, which is different from the chest organs.
wrong.2: The brain is protected by the hard, bony structure called the skull.
wrong.3: The stomach is protected by soft tissues and muscles, not the ribs.

quiz.say: If you want to know what gives you your height and shape, you look at:
quiz.why: The skeleton is the entire framework, providing the main support structure for your whole body.

wrong.0: Cartilage is soft, and the skeleton is the harder, main support system.
wrong.2: Skin is a covering, but the skeleton is the internal support structure.
wrong.3: Muscles pull to move, but the bones are what provide the underlying frame.
